Site Map for Mädchen Gebhard’s Thesis: A subset of Shallow and Mesophotic coral reefs from the Territorial Coral Reef Monitoring Program

Data is available from Hollander et al. (2025) and the Territorial Coral Reef Monitoring Program.





Colored map of the U.S. Virgin Islands. Mesophotic points shown in purple and shallow points shown in green. Top panel shows St. Thomas and St. John. Bottom panel shows St. Croix with an excerpt map of the Caribbean Sea.







Degree Heating Week’s (DHW) per Site

Shallow SitesMesophotic Sites



Black PointBotany BayBrewers BaySeahorse Cottage ShoalSouth CapellaSouth Water







Black Point, left-most green pin, is a shallow site (9 m) with an average coral richness of 13 species and an average abundance of 101 corals.











Botany Bay is a shallow site (8 m) with an average coral richness of 9 species and an average abundance of 42 corals.











Brewers Bay, right-most green pin, is a shallow site (6 m) with an average coral richness of 6 species and an average abundance of 30 corals.











Seahorse Cottage Shoal is a shallow site (20 m) with an average coral richness of 12 species and an average abundance of 81 corals.











South Capella is a shallow site (20 m) with an average coral richness of 6 species and an average abundance of 18 corals.











South Water is a shallow site (20 m) with an average coral richness of 6 species and an average abundance of 16 corals.










Buck Island St. Croix DeepCollege Shoal EastGrammanik Tiger FSAHind Bank East FSALang Bank Red Hind FSAMeri Shoal







Buck Island St. Croix Deep is a mesophotic site (33 m) with an average coral richness of 5 species and an average abundance of 15 corals.











College Shoal East is a mesophotic site (30 m) with an average coral richness of 5 species and an average abundance of 20 corals.











Grammanik Tiger FSA is a mesophotic site (38 m) with an average coral richness of 5 species and an average abundance of 19 corals.











Hind Bank East FSA is a shallow site (41 m) with an average coral richness of 7 species and an average abundance of 18 corals.











Lang Bank Red Hind FSA is a shallow site (33 m) with an average coral richness of 6 species and an average abundance of 18 corals.











Meri Shoal is a shallow site (30 m) with an average coral richness of 5 species and an average abundance of 24 corals.
